modelHeader.A4_1_churn: When a quit ends a session, with probability 0.4 the user churns PERMANENTLY (no more answers); otherwise a new session starts as before.

pickers.v2a: pickerV2 original: quotas 60/25/15, difficulty target accuracy 0.65
pickers.v2b: pickerV2 tuned (B2): quotas 45/20/35 for the first 50 answers then 60/25/15, difficulty target accuracy 0.70; streak cap, cold start, mastery estimate and spaced-review rules identical to v2a
